digest.component_or_area: Ruff linting configuration and timezone validation
propositions: Ruff ASYNC and DTZ check families must be enabled in the global linting ratchet across src/rebar and tests directories

All datetime operations must use explicit timezone semantics: epoch seconds via datetime.timezone.utc, persisted strings without offset interpreted as UTC, and host-local calendar dates via aware now() with tz= parameter
The literal datetime.UTC token is prohibited because target-version is py310; only datetime.timezone.utc is permitted
Security-pin cadence logic must obtain an aware current instant with explicit timezone argument, convert to host timezone, and extract the resulting local calendar date
Six pre-existing ASYNC and DTZ diagnostics across validate_checks.py, security_pin.py, test_jira_onboard.py, and test_review_bot.py must be resolved before enabling the ratchet
Timezone invariance must be proved under at least two distinct TZ process values on POSIX/macOS platforms using time.tzset()
